message.reasoning_content: We need to determine statutory charges under Chinese law for environmental pollution. The facts: illegal discharge of waste water containing heavy metals exceeding standards. Likely violation of "污染环境罪" (Environmental Pollution Crime) under the Criminal Law of PRC. Specifically, Article 338 of Criminal Law: "违反国家规定，非法倾倒、排放、处置有毒有害物质，造成严重后果的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Also could be "非法排放污染物罪". The charge: "非法排放污染物罪" (illegal discharge of pollutants). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "非法排放污染物罪". So answer: [罪名]非法排放污染物罪<eoa>
